plan.notes: Iowa State University 2026-2027 catalog, Psychology B.S. official Four Year Plan ('Four Year Plans' tab; the B.A. plan is not transcribed). Credit ranges recorded at catalog minimum: World Language/Elective 3-4 cr recorded as 3; plan total 120-122, transcribed minimum 120. Generic breadth slots (Psychology Choice, Natural Science, Social Sciences, Arts and Humanities, Electives) are recorded as choice placeholders using the official plan's slot labels. PSYCH 3010/3020 form the required research methods sequence. The plan requires a C- or better and 2.00 average in required psychology courses.
